evidence.note: The data source kind offers only UsernamePassword authentication, labelled 'Username or Client id' and 'Password or Client secret'.

If the URL contains /oauth2, the stored username and password are posted to /oauth2/token as client_id and client_secret, and the returned token is sent as a Bearer header. The kind does not declare OAuth, so this is not counted as oauth.
All data requests go through Web.Contents against the AIH OData-style REST endpoints.
Dataset pages are fetched with Web.Contents.
URL is the environment URL; Database names the CCH Tagetik database.
The optional AW (analytical workspace code) and Dataset parameters name resources inside the target.
Optional options record (FinancialModel, AWDatasets, StartDate, EndDate). Contents3 instead takes FinancialOptions, AnalyticalOptions and AdvancedOptions records.
Contents2 takes StartDate and EndDate datetime parameters (Range Start/End) used to filter the fact data.

options-fields.text: FinancialModel (text, '1' or '2'), AWDatasets (comma-separated workspace_dataset codes), StartDate (datetime), EndDate (datetime). Contents3 spreads the same fields over three records: FinancialOptions[FinancialModel], AnalyticalOptions[AWDatasets], AdvancedOptions[StartDate, EndDate].

evidence.note: Reads FinancialModel, AWDatasets, StartDate and EndDate from the options record.
Reads the same fields from the three option records.
Page-number paging: the page count N_PAGINATION is read from the server first (Dataset_AWT018).
Each page is requested with a $filter of P eq '<n>' for n in {1..N_PAGINATION}, and the pages are combined.
Dataset pages use the same P eq '<index>' filter over {1..DatasetNrPages}.
Pages come from List.Transform over a precomputed index list {1..FactTableNrPages}, not from List.Generate or Table.GenerateByPage.
List.Transform over {1..Number.From(DatasetNrPages)}.

paging-stop.text: Paging covers a fixed number of pages that the server reports up front: N_PAGINATION from Dataset_AWT018 for the fact table (1 if null) or from Dataset_AWT002 for analytical datasets. Every page from 1 to that count is fetched, and empty pages are filtered out afterwards.

evidence.note: Page count comes from N_PAGINATION, defaulting to 1.
Iterates 1..N and drops pages with no rows.
Responses are parsed with Json.Document; rows are expanded from the OData 'value' list and pipe-delimited K strings are split into columns.
Table.View GetType declares a typed table type for the fact table; every dimension source does the same.
The connector maps source FIELD_TYPE names to M types to type dataset columns.
Table.TransformColumnTypes converts the fact-table columns to text and AMOUNT to number (en-US).
Dataset columns are converted with Table.TransformColumnTypes using the mapped types.
If the value list is empty, the page returns an empty table built with the declared column names.
Dimension sources fall back to an empty table with the declared column names.
Data requests set no ManualStatusHandling, so Power Query handles status codes. IsRetry=true on some calls only bypasses the cache; it is not a delayed retry.
Documentation.Name and Documentation.LongDescription on the function type.
Documentation.FieldCaption, FieldDescription and SampleValues on the parameters.
Documentation.AllowedValues {"1","2"} on FinancialModel.
The financial navigation table is a hardcoded list of dimension and fact-table rows.
Analytical dataset items are listed at runtime from the Dataset_AWT002 API.
Folder rows with IsLeaf=false (Dimensions, Hierarchies, Datasets, Financial Features, User Rights) open nested navigation tables.
TestConnection returns {"CCHTagetik.Contents", URL, Database}, so the gateway test runs a normal query.
All code is in a single section file.
Labels come from Extension.LoadString.
Icon16 and Icon32 PNG resources.
Diagnostics.Trace(TraceLevel.Error, ...) runs with no gating switch when the environment or model is invalid.
Ungated Diagnostics.Trace on error paths.
